references.text: The prophet Isaiah speaks of rejoicing in the Lord and being clothed with garments of salvation and a robe of righteousness, which can be seen as a precursor to the idea of wedding garments in Matthew.
The psalm describes a royal wedding scene where the bride is dressed in exquisite clothing, which may reflect the significance of being properly attired for the marriage feast of heaven.
Revelation speaks of the fine linen of the saints, which represents the righteous acts of the righteous, something that can be connected to the wedding garments in the parable.

Revelation also mentions the clothing of those who are worthy, whose names will not be blotted out from the book of life, which can be seen in connection with being properly dressed for God's presence.
